title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre - University of California on 1982-05-21
lineage: CD -> Samplitude Pro fessional v10.1 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M) -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear Charlie Miller soundboard captures a high‑energy second set highlighted by the blazing Playin' > Uncle John's Band sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording is a superb soundboard capture with crisp, clear balance and only a minor flutter on Sugar Magnolia. Musically the show shines in its second set – the Playin' > UJB suite (including the reprise into Black Peter) is repeatedly praised as one of the band’s finest moments of 1982, while the first set delivers solid energy, especially on Sugar Magnolia.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (average ~4.1) and enthusiastic comments about both the pristine soundboard recording and the standout second‑set jams justify a rating in the 4.0–4.5 range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Beautiful, clear Charlie Miller sound; crisp mix throughout with only minor flutter on Sugar Magnolia.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, cohesive flow with a particularly fire‑filled second set; transitions praised, first set solid though less highlighted.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry's playing is described as powerful and even 'out of this world'; minor lyric slip on Black Peter noted but overall stellar.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob (Bobby) gets credit for a beautiful jam into the drums with Brent, adding extra sparkle to the set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Early Brent era is highlighted; keyboards are praised as part of the overall tight sound but no specific solo remarks.
